step-jack.criteria: Alternate one foot stepping laterally and returning while both arms lift overhead and lower. Supporting ankle remains fixed; no jumping.

squat-jack.criteria: Jump feet outward, land then lower into a wide squat; rise and jump feet together. Hands held in front as described in the tips; not the alternate floor-touch variation in the numbered instructions.

high-knee-skip.criteria: Rope-free variation (source permits with or without rope): alternating high knee drive with a small vertical hop and opposite arm swing. Illustrated in place at a slower teaching pace.

sourceKind: Original procedural skinned animation informed by training references; no copied reference imagery.
limits: Slow four-second cycle for demonstration, not a prescribed training cadence. Barefoot procedural character. No exhaustive cloth collision simulation or physical-phone verification.
